outputs.explanation: Stacked area/bar chart shows median state frequency trends across ~continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins for thousands of promoters; this is a continuous trend representation analogous to a line/area plot, where overlaying individual promoter data points would be unreadable and is not the intended annotation type.

This is a single-molecule stack plot where every row already represents one individual DNA molecule's methylation status, so individual data points are inherently displayed rather than an aggregate summary.
Same stacked area/bar representation as panel A (mouse data), showing median trends across continuous bins; exempt like a line/area plot.
Single-molecule stack plot (mouse Skp1 locus) where each row is an individual molecule, so individual data points are already shown.
Box plots showing PIC occupancy distributions; box plots are exempt from requiring separate individual point overlays as they already display the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers).
